title: Nurse Manager: Escalation draft
notice: Demo with sample data only. It is not connected to your organization's data, and it should not be.
question: 4 West can't fix the IV pump problem at our level. Get the escalation ready for the next tier, but don't page anyone until I confirm.

answer.question: 4 West can't fix the IV pump problem at our level. Get the escalation ready for the next tier, but don't page anyone until I confirm.
answer.answer:
The escalation for HB-2041 (IV pumps) is drafted. Nothing has moved and no one has been paged.

**Why it goes up:** Two pumps are out of service and three infusions this shift have no pump. One antibiotic dose is due at 14:00. Tier 1 already borrowed a pump from 4 East (returned at 07:00) and opened biomedical ticket BME-5531.

**Who gets paged in Teams once you confirm:**
- Rachel Ng, Director of Medical-Surgical Nursing
- Marcus Bell, Biomedical Engineering Supervisor
- Copy: Jordan Pike, who raised the issue

**Clock:** The issue is 2 hours past its 8-hour Tier 1 target. On escalation, the clock restarts at the Tier 2 target of 24 hours, due Sat 04:19, and is reviewed at the 09:15 department huddle.

To send it, confirm on the huddle board itself. I can't send or move the escalation from here.
